OUR STORY

Started at one table, built for every table

The Kongvene Table started as a Facebook group (originally called The Kongvene Table) because I wanted a place where mahjong players of every level — brand new, rusty, or been-playing-since-the-90s — could actually talk shop without feeling like they'd wandered into the wrong room.

Beginners get their rules questions answered without judgment. Longtime players get somewhere to talk cards, strategy, and the culture around the game. And once in a while, we talk about the tools that make organizing a regular game easier — including Kongvene, the app I built for exactly that.

BUILT BY A MAMI, FOR MAHJONG GROUPS

Kongvene

The part of running a regular mahjong group that isn't the game itself — who's in this week, whose turn it is to host, who still owes for last time — Kongvene handles it so your group can just show up and play.

Get it on the App Store kongvene.com
  • RSVP, sorted into tables. "I'm In" or "I'm Out," seated automatically at tables of four, subs promoted in if someone drops.
  • Host Rotation. Alphabetical turn order, one tap to pass hosting to the next person.
  • Need a Fourth. A broadcast to your circle when a table's short a player.
  • Dues Tracker. Who's paid for game day and who hasn't, with a Venmo/Cash App request built in.

Free to join and use for every member. Organizer-only features are being introduced gradually, with a heads-up to the community before anything changes.
